subject: CYCLE-1 TEST-RESULT: Artifactory NG REG/3 shadow baseline passes; live-head reconciliation still required
body: Cycle 1 baseline executed against the canonical Research V5 bundled Artifactory NG V3 shadow trial. validate_shadow_trial.py returned VALIDATION_OK, verifying root SHA closure, exact three role-package lookup, schemas, package digests/internal manifests/role identity, snapshot closure, clean restore/bootstrap for all three roles, snapshot role ZIP byte hashes, ZIP path-escape rejection, and the non-mutation boundary. The dedicated unit suite passed 12/12 tests, including bad outer hash rejection, exactly-three role loading, idempotent finalization, authority-invariant profile switching, mirror states, stale Primary fencing, lease conflict fail-closed, highest-epoch uniqueness, recovery sweep, required-write failure not terminal, no live promotion grant, and ZIP-slip rejection. These PASS results prove the bundled shadow fixture is internally coherent only; they do NOT prove current-head mirror completeness or canonical-role lineage because the shadow trial was authored against 28842ae and its REG/3 role ZIPs are REFERENCE_ONLY. Cycle 2 will therefore adversarially validate the root-safe mirror at current HEAD 1cf46d75 and canonical V7/V5/V5 role hashes, with corruption/count/fencing/recovery cases.
